thread:
maria: heads up — product is planning a 2-week winter promo that changes free-tier daily quotas on Dec 1. PM expects ~3x signin traffic and 1.5x hosted inference calls. Can infra ops run a quick capacity forecast?

omar: got it — do we have the exact quota/type changes? rate limits, token caps, or rate per-minute?

maria: PM sent this: 
- free tier: 100r/d -> 250r/d, burst window 60s -> 120s
- new trial: 30k token cap for first 7 days then revert
Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-999

kevin: short version: higher concurrent short sessions + longer streaming windows. We'll likely see more small gen requests and some extended streams.

jess: rough baseline numbers from last promo (Q4 last year):
```
avg daily gpu-hours: 420
peak hourly gpus: 28
median seq len: 24
requests/day: 1.2M
```
Expectation from PM: +50-70% requests/day, but +20-40% GPU-hours due to short gen bias.

omar: i ran a quick sim against our 90-day traffic shape with the promo multipliers (x1.6 requests, x1.25 token usage). Results:
```
projected avg daily gpu-hours: 520
projected peak hourly gpus: 36
95th p95 latency impact if no pre-warm: +18%
```
Assumptions: same batching efficiency, no KV-cache hit improvement.

lisa: can we absorb that on Dedicated pools then? We have some spare cap in us-west but eu-west is tight (50% utilized). Also network egress limits in eu-west could be hit if embedding traffic spikes.

sre-bot: Alert: eu-west egress at 72% of monthly cap. Recommend throttling large downloads and enabling compression for embedding payloads.

kevin: for safety i'd recommend two actions: 1) pre-warm +20% extra GPU instances in us-west and us-east for the first week, 2) enable adaptive rate limit fallback to low-quant models for non-pay customers. That reduces tail GPU time.

maria: cost question — what does pre-warming +20% for one week cost? Rough estimate.

omar: cost calc quick: baseline hourly infra cost (spot+infra) ~ $1.80 per GPU-hour. Extra 20% of avg daily 520 -> 104 gpu-hours/day * 7 days = 728 gpu-hours. 728 * $1.8 ≈ $1,310. With reserved buffers and region differences, budget for $1.6k.

jess: note: if we do quantized fast models for free tier fallbacks we can cut cost per token ~40% but need a canary to check quality regressions. I can run a 24h eval set.

lisa: network mitigation: switch embeddings uploads to gzipped protobufs for promo. SRE, can we flip that in a config toggle?

sre-bot: Actionable: created incident 6221 - "promo network mitigation". Assigned to @lisa and @kevin.

kevin: one more thing — we should update the rollout policy to do region-first fallbacks: route eu requests to us-east fallback if eu capacity > 85% to prevent hard OOMs. Ops ticket please.

maria: thanks. next steps:
- @omar to finalize GPU-hours forecast and post updated numbers by EOD today
- @jess to run 24h quality eval on low-quant fallback by tomorrow noon
- @lisa to implement gzip toggle and check egress caps
- @kevin to prepare pre-warm plan and update routing fallback policy
- @sre-bot to track incident 6221 and alert if eu-west > 80%

Any blockers? :thumbsup:
